observations: Continuous photographed oak grain replaces broad procedural waves; upright panels and lengthwise rails/shelves now follow joinery.
Continuous coherent CC0 granite avoids mortar joints; its .5m repeat and honed/cut roughness finishes are explicitly authored.
Photographed 1m plaster microdetail and baked pale paint retain source roughness/normal; indoor2mterrazzo differs from outdoorcobbles.
Exterior feet/entrance and indoorfloor sharez0 with no coplanar terrain overlap.
ActualGodotimport retains sourceUVscale/offset and originalPBRtextures; procedural daylight is a separate presentation from BlenderAgX.
limitations: This is one cafe/street exemplar, not a rebuilt whole town or migrated playable scene.
Shutters/canvas/context neighbors remain simplified; no end-grain texture, upstairs rooms, complete service layout, collision/navigation/performance certification.
Small roof/shadow aliasing remains in the GLCompatibility overview; no claim of renderer/art parity.
The fullprecisionpermissivemodeltest was interrupted by an unexpectedhostrebootat7/50steps. NoAI-producedmaterialisused, no quality-equivalenceclaim or GPU retry.
